texts.preamble: Smt.Deepu @ V. Lakshmidevi vs H.Manjunath on 20 February, 2020 In The Court Of Metropolitan Magistrate Traffic Court - V, Bengaluru Present : Smt.Pooja Shetti Ba., Ll.B. (Hons). M.M.T.C - V, Bengaluru Dated This 20th Day Of February 2020 Crl. Misc.No.192 - 2012 Petitioners: 1. Smt.Deepu @ V. Lakshmidevi, W/o.H.Manjunath, Aged about 26 years. 2. Master Jayanth, S/o.H.Manjunath, Minor. 3. Kumari.Jahnavi, D/o.H.Manjunath, Minor. Petitioner No.2 and 3 being minors are represented by their next friend, guardian and mother Smt.V.Lakshmidevi @ Deepu. (Petitioner No.1 herein). All are residing at No.145, 'Sri Renukamba Nivasa', Bhavaninagara, Channaiahnapalya, Nagasandra Post, Bengaluru - 560 073. // Vs // Respondents : 1. H.Manjunath, S/o.M.Hanumaiah, Major. 2. M.Hanumaiah, 2 Crl. Misc.No.192 - 2012
texts.facts: ORDER This is the petition filed by the petitioner against the respondents under section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act., 2005 (herein after referred as P.W.D.V. Act, 2005) seeking various relief. 2. The brief facts of the petitioners case is as follows; The marriage of the 1st petitioner with the 1st respondent was solemnized on 10.10.2005 at Sri Jayasurya Kalyana Mantapa, Bylappanapalya, Tumkur road, Bengaluru as per Hindu customs and rituals in the presence of relatives, friends and well wishers. It is the submission of petitioner No.1 that, at the time of marriage, the respondent No.1 was working as driver on temporary basis in Revenue Department and he was earning Rs.12,500/- per month, and the respondents demanded dowry and gold ornaments from the petitioner and the same as been fulfilled by her father and he has performed marriage by spending Rs.10,00,000/-. After the marriage, the petitioner started to reside with her in-laws. 3. The petitioner further submits that, her sister-in-law one Hemavathi is a spinster and she used to reside with the respondent and his parents. The said Hemavathi used to control whole family and both the respondents used to give their earnings to her. According to petitioner, the said Hemavathi used to give some meager amount to the petitioner out of which the petitioner has to manage the whole house. Hence, within 4 months of marriage, the petitioner became very weak and when the 1st respondent question the same, the petitioner informed the 1st respondent about the problem, hence when the 1st respondent questioned the same to the Hemavathi, she threatened the 1st petitioner and 1st respondent to leave the house stating or else she will commit suicide. For which, the mother-in-law of the petitioner has also supported to the said Hemavathi, therefore the 1st respondent moved out of the house and took a separate rental house at Pattegarapalya and it is the father of the petitioner who had helped the 1st respondent financially and maintained both the 1st petitioner and 1st respondent. 4. The petitioner further submits that, during the said period, the 2nd petitioner was born and the delivery expenses were borne by the parents of the petitioner. According to petitioner, after making separate house, respondent started to consume more and more alcohol, and after delivery when she was at her parent's house and one day, the 1st respondent shifted all the house hold articles and dumped the same before the house of her parents and took the advance amount to utilize the same for his bad habits. Thereafter, the parents of the petitioner had arranged one more rental house at Chikkabidarakallu by paying Rs.20,000/- towards advance and Rs.2,100/- towards rent, however the respondent failed to pay the rent and it is the parents of the petitioner who looked after both petitioner No.1 and 2, during this period, the 3rd petitioner was born. 5. She further submits that, in September 2009, the 1st respondent informed the 1st petitioner that he has lost his job at Revenue Department and he is working as a driver job in Airport Taxi Service Smt.Deepu @ V. Lakshmidevi vs H.Manjunath on 20 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29006526/ 2 and he demanded Rs.1,50,000/- from the petitioner to purchase a second hand taxi. However, the 1st petitioner refused and asked the respondent to ask his father as he is a government employee and also has agricultural land, hence the respondent got angry and assaulted the petitioner black and blue and also abused her in filthy language and burnt her with cigarette butts, he also has a beaten the 2nd and 3rd petitioners and after taking gold chain from steel almirah he ran away from the house. Hence, the petitioner fell unconscious and the same was informed by the neighbors to her parents and her parents came and took her to the hospital wherein she took treatment for 2 days. 6. The petitioner further submits that, after the incident, she and her parents went to police station and lodged complaint against the respondent, hence, one of the relative of the 1st respondent came to the police station and requested the 1st petitioner and her parents not to lodge complaint and in that panchayath, the 1st respondent asked apologized and assured that he will not commit any offence in future. Similarly, the 2nd respondent also undertook to retrieve the pledged gold ornaments by the 1st respondent and also to buy a taxi to the 1st respondent, however they did not kept their promise. The petitioner further submits that, 1st respondent started to force her to act in blue films telling that, he has foreign clients and if she act nobody will know about the same. According to petitioner, the respondent used to stay away from house days together and whenever he returns he used to suspect her character. She further submits that, 1st respondent used to mix DDT powder and his urine to the drinking water of the petitioners. The respondent No.1 also failed to admitted the 2nd petitioner to the school and when petitioner No.1 informed the same to the 2nd respondent, the 2nd respondent assured that he will admit the 2nd petitioner to the school , however he did not kept his words. Hence, father of the petitioner No.1 admitted the 2nd petitioner to the school by paying all the school fees. 8. She further submits that, in the month of November 2010, the said Hemavathi along with her parents came to the house of the 1st petitioner in the disguise of solving the problem of the 1st petitioner and 1st respondent and the mother-in-law of the petitioner had stolen 180 grams of gold ornaments of petitioner. She further submits that, whole families of the respondents are thieves and mother of the 1st respondent knows black magic. She further submits that, in the month of August 2011, the respondent No.1 in the disguise of getting the 1st petitioner's gold ornaments from his mother and also in the guise of attending a function in his parents house took her to his parents in a motorcycle where he tried to kill the petitioner by stopping motorcycle in the middle of the road, hence the petitioner returned back to the home, therefore the 1st respondent came to the 1st petitioners house and started to assault her and tried to kill her by pouring diesel over her and tried to ignite, at that time fortunately her father came and the 1st respondent has also assaulted the petitioner's father, during said period the neighbors also came and they telephoned Hoysala Police and in the meanwhile, the 1st respondent escaped from the clutches and ran away, thereafter the owner of the house asked 1st petitioner to vacate the house having regard to the safety of the petitioners, she vacated the house and went to her fathers house wherein the 1st respondent came along with some anti social elements and assaulted the 1st petitioners father and threatened them to Smt.Deepu @ V. Lakshmidevi vs H.Manjunath on 20 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29006526/ 3 saying that, he will eliminate the entire family, hence the petitioner lodged a compliant before the police against the 1st respondent, wherein the 1st respondent was arrested and sent to the jail. 9. She further submits that, while working as driver at Airport Taxi Service, the 1st respondent had stolen Laptop, cheques and other documents of the passengers and he was booked for the said offence and he was sent to the jail for that also. She further submits that, she is a housewife and has no income and both the petitioner and her children are depending upon her parents. On the other hand, the 1st respondent is working as a driver at Airport Taxi Service and earning salary of more than Rs.10,000/- and 1st respondent and his sister Hemavathi are holding petitioners gold jewelleries worth Rs.2,50,000/- which belongs to the petitioners. Hence, the petition. 10. After the registration of the petition, notice has been issued to the respondents through RPAD and P.O. After the service of said notice, 1st respondent appeared before the court and filed his objection to the main petition. In his objection, respondent except admitting 1st petitioner's marriage with him denied all other allegations. It is the contention of the respondent that, at the time of marriage, he never demanded dowry or has taken dowry from the petitioner. According to respondent, petitioner and her parents belongs to poor family and he has helped them and never taken help from them, even at the time of delivery, it is him who has met medical expenses of the petitioner and after marriage, the petitioner only stayed for 45 days in his parents house, thereafter she started to harass him for separate house, when his family members were unable to bear the torture, they asked him to arrange a separate house, hence they moved to a rented house which was situated nearer to her parent's house and stayed their for 6 month, thereafter, they again shifted their house to another house which was also situated nearer to the house of petitioner. According to respondent, petitioner is making false allegations against his mother and sister, his sister is married and he had only meager salary of Rs.2,000/- to Rs.2,500/- and he never handed over his salary to his sister. The respondent further submits that, at the instigation of her father, petitioner is making false allegations against him and they have a relative by name Krishnappa, who is working as a P.C in Bengaluru Police Station and as per his advise, they have drafted the complaint against the respondent for the allegation of dowry harassment. According to respondent, on 21.11.2011, his father-in-law and brother-in-law by name Gururaj has beaten him and has caused grievous injuries, when the police arrived at the spot, they took the 1st respondent to the hospital and got him treated, thereafter they produced him before Jurisdictional Magistrate and a case was registered and without any fault, he was sent to judicial custody, due to the false complaint of the petitioner, which has caused mental agony to him. He further submits that, he has no friend by name William and all the allegations made by the petitioner are false, he never suspected her character and till today, he is ready to look after the petitioner and his children, if she rejoins him by forging her illegal acts. Hence, prays to dismiss the petition. 11. In order to prove her case, petitioner got herself examined as PW.1 and also another witness examined as RW.2 and got 45 document marked as Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.45. On the other hand, respondent in their defence examined respondent as RW.1 and got 4 documents marked as Ex.R.1 to Ex.R.4.
texts.arguments: 7. The petitioner further submits that, the 1st respondent used to say that he has a foreign friend by name Williams and if the 1st petitioner does not co-operative with him, he will marry the sister of William and will settle in a foreign country and used to demand the divorce from the 1st petitioner. In Vijay Verma Vs. State (NCT) of Delhi and another., reported in AIR 2011 (NOC) 171 (DEL), the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi held that, "the purpose of the Act is to give remedy to the aggrieved persons against domestic violence. 19. The petitioner further contends that, the respondent No.1 failed to provide basic necessities and also failed to pay the rent of the rented premises. According to petitioner, when the respondent lost his job at Revenue Department, he asked petitioner to bring money to buy a second hand taxi, when she refused and asked him to get money from his father, he assaulted petitioner and her children and stole a gold chain from the house and ran away. Hence, she approached jurisdictional police, wherein after panchayath, the 1st respondent appolized and assured that, he will not commit any offence in future. According to petitioner, 2nd respondent assured to retrieve the gold ornaments pledged by 1st respondent and to handover the same to petitioner and also to buy a taxi. During her cross-examination dated 26.10.2013, the witness deposes that, she has lodged complaint against the respondent. In the complaint, petitioner has alleged that, the respondent is demanding jewellary and on her failure, he is asking to divorce him, which is in contradiction with the allegations made by the petitioner in her affidavit. Thereafter, witness denies the suggestion that, on 21.11.2011, her brother and father have assaulted the respondent, hence he has sustained injuries. Thereafter, when it has been suggested that, due to the injuries the respondent has taken treatment, the witness claims that, when the respondent was assaulting her father, a stone touched him, hence he sustained injuries. The above admission is in support of the contention of the respondent that, the parents and brother of the petitioner has assaulted him and lodged false complaint against him. 20. The petitioner further contends that, the respondent used to force her to act in blue films and used to sexually abuse her. According to petitioner, he used to mix DDT powder and his urine to the drinking water of the petitioners. During her cross-examination dated 26.10.2013, the witness deposes that, she has not lodged any complaint against the respondent stating that, he is forcing her to act in blue films. Further, according to petitioner, in her unconsciousness state, she does not know, as to what respondent did to her and PW.2 supports her contention, however being father of petitioner, obviously he will support the allegations of the petitioner and 21. The petitioner though has contended that, the respondent tried to ignite her by pouring diesel in the month of November and her neighbor had called Hoysala Police, still no complaint was filed against the respondent on the said day. According to petitioner, after vacating the house, when she moved to her father's house, the respondent came near her father's house along with some anti social elements and assaulted her father, then she lodged complaint against him. On the other hand, it is the contention of the respondent that, petitioner has a relative by name Krishnappa who is working as a P.C. in Bengaluru Police Station and as per his advise, the petitioner drafted complaint by making false allegations of dowry harassment against him and on 21.11.2011, petitioner's father and brother assaulted him and caused grievous injuries to him and on the same day, he was arrested Smt.Deepu @ V. Lakshmidevi vs H.Manjunath on 20 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29006526/ 7 due to the false complaint of the petitioner.
